notes.title: Version 0.9.3
notes.notes:
-Fixed a logic error that allowed catapults to deal damage from very long distances.
-Added an information arrow indicating the location of the flag that needs to be defended at the beginning of the 3rd map.
-Fixed a bug that sometimes left one sales slot empty in the market.
-Added some informative texts and made minor UI adjustments.
-Added new sound effects for certain actions.
-While in the market, the features provided to soldiers in the squad can be viewed by hovering the mouse over the soldiers.
-Soldiers display a reload animation while reloading ammunition.
-When leveling up, players now randomly gain some features. Currently, leveling up grants the player a random attribute increase, a certain amount of HP increase, and an increase of 1 in bomb quantity.
-Adjusted item balancing and the number of enemies in levels.

Added Manual Firing Option for Team Leader:
A new manual firing feature has been introduced for team leaders, allowing players to take direct control of the team leader's weapon. This enhancement enables precise aiming and firing, giving players greater tactical flexibility during gameplay. Players can switch between manual and automatic firing modes based on their preference. If desired, the automatic firing mode can still be enabled to maintain the previous behavior where the team leader fires automatically without player intervention.

notes.title: Version 0.9.2
notes.notes:
-Fixed some translation errors.
-Fixed bugs that caused certain items to not provide the necessary stats.
-Added support for 3440x1440 resolution at the request of a Boomcestors enthusiast.
-Added two different environmental effects:
Rain: Can occur randomly on any map and slows enemies by 10% when it happens.
Mountainous Terrain: Active in Map 2, increases the cost of support units by 50%.
-Fixed the map issue that caused drones to not function as intended in Map 2.
-In response to feedback that the first map was excessively difficult, the number of enemies has been slightly reduced, and the chances of encountering soldiers and weapons in the market at the start have been slightly increased.
-The cost of support units now increases slightly as they are used (limited to the current attack only).
-Fixed a visual bug in the item locking system in the market.

-Explosive ammunition now deals damage to units with black shields. Additionally, explosive ammunition has been slightly weakened due to feedback that they were too powerful.

-Added the "Protect the Flag" mission to Map 3. Players must now ensure that the flag does not fall while fighting enemy waves.

-Added the "Protect the City's Gate" mission to Map 4. Players must now ensure that the gate does not fall while fighting enemy waves.

notes.title: Boomcestors Release News
notes.notes:
Hello,

Today, Boomcestors became available in Early Access. The game includes all the features mentioned in the store description. These are:

-16 unique soldiers, each with their own special traits.
-11 powerful weapons at your disposal.
-Hundreds of items available for purchase with gold earned between attacks.
-The ability to manipulate the stats of enemies, your squad, and weapon types, depending on which items you acquire.
-4 distinct maps.
-19 diverse enemy types.
-Upgradeable squad attributes.


Currently, I’m working on the following content, which will be added in the next update:
-Adding new items and balance adjustments,
-Introducing unique missions for Levels 3 and 4,
-Adding and expanding achievements,
-Adding new music tracks and improving the sound system,
-Making adjustments based on player feedback.

I plan to release the next update within 1–2 weeks.

Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to me and will be carefully considered during this process. I hope you enjoy playing Boomcestors. Have fun!
